phrases.latin: Theodōrus, ā pollice incipiēns, singula nōmina singulīs digitīs numerāvit
phrases.english: Theo, starting with his thumb, counted one name on each finger
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 58, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
